data: batch010-A BTC/ETH 5m Jan1-2 2025 checksum-verified retrospective OHLCV; no PIT or bid/ask

D1.I2_A: direction*(last_child_close-first_child_open)/sum(abs(child_close-child_open)); zero=>null; Q_DEV normalizer allows ratio outside[-1,1]
D1.I2_B: equal mean(Q_DEV(A),retention,consistency); retention=clip(directional net/max favorable excursion,0,1), consistency=fraction of direction-positive child bodies
D1.I4_A: sum second-half child quote volume / total child quote volume; zero=>null
D1.I4_B_quote: same B with quote RVOL, separate arm not interchangeable
D1.S4_A: mean directional close-location of last closed daily andweekly candle; missing=>null
D1.S4_B: equal mean(S4_A,last closed8h directional close-location,causal20closed4h channel-position); missing=>null

D2.I3: Q_DEV directional latest5m C2C; linear monotonic research hypothesis only
D2.I5: D mean directional close-location on latest closed1h/4h; causal context proxy, not approved BOS
D2.S1: D causal20closed4h channel-position; pivot confirmation trailing only; no inferred BOS/CHoCH

normalization: Q_DEV midrank=(#less+0.5#equal)/N; fitted sorted DEV finite only; tails0/1; missing/null; R alternative0.5+atan((x-median)/(1.4826*MAD))/pi, MAD0=>null; fixed group weights unchanged; no V2 emitted with missing groups

D3.t0: first full5m bar strictly after parentclose+60s decision; reference open; descriptive nonexecutable
D3.outcome: direction*(close at exactt0+H - open_t0)/open_t0; gross not net
D3.baseline: paired sameasset/time fixedUP direction; DOWN descriptive notshort
D3.alternative: firsthit +/-1% overH, both hit inone5mbar=>UNKNOWN, never infer order
D3.setups: causal directional parentROC sign; EARLY priorparentROC=0, CONTINUATION same prior sign, REVERSAL oppositeprior sign; no eligible setup if missing; this is candidate label not semantic truth
D3.metric: primary DEV paired Pearson correlation(feature,directional gross outcome), compare B-A within same asset and setup; economicqualification unavailablewithoutcosts

D4: strict independently evidenced close<=publication<=sourceavailable<=receipt<=decision, uncertainty<1s, source attestation required; retrospective archives cannotpass; no synthetic timestamps

D5.sampleunit: asset+parentclose cluster; directions/setups notindependent; reportdayblocks for uncertainty
D5.purge: DEVoutcomeend mustprecedeJan2 boundary; OOScontext mayusepastDEVbars but normalizer neverOOS; 24hSwing training mostlyinsufficient
D5.selection: no winner unless adequate independent clusters and corrected evidence; otherwise freezeA as simpler diagnostic comparator, neverapprovedwinner
D5.power: min detectable correlation.1,power.8, Fisher-z independentcluster planning; actualeffectiveN undetermined without adequate dependence estimates
D5.controls: DEVlabel permutation fixedseed42; reverse/time-shift features diagnostics; nofutureinput/holdoutleakage
D5.stop: PIT_FAIL_HOLD and wholeV2unavailable; noqualifyingOOS/Forward claim; Forward depends on independent publisher/time evidence and futureaccrual
